title: Hero hours chip renders the raw float sum, so tenth-hour shifts show '36.900000000000006 hrs'
where: index.html:3489 (`{calc.hours} hrs · {periodShiftCount} shifts`) vs index.html:3496 and index.html:3970 which use toFixed
detail: calc.hours is a plain accumulator over `s.hours` (index.html:2795-2802). The hours NumInput (index.html:4226) commits any parseFloat value — `step="0.5"` is only a spinner hint — and Kronos-style timekeeping rounds to tenths, so 12.3h / 8.1h entries are realistic. The stats tile and Year view both format hours with `toFixed(h%1?1:0)`; the hero chip is the one surface that prints the float directly. Verified in Node: 12.3+12.3+12.3 = 36.900000000000006; 8.1+8.2 = 16.299999999999997.
failure: Three 12.3h shifts in the period: hero chip reads '36.900000000000006 hrs · 3 shifts' while the stats tile directly beneath reads '36.9'.
fix: Use the same formatter as the stats tile: `{calc.hours.toFixed(calc.hours%1?1:0)} hrs`.
